backbone: torchvision.resnet18(weights=None), load local ImageNet state; discard FC, eval frozen GAP512
eligibility: finite predicted corner in raw image and not initial H self-hidden; no CAL label filter during extraction
crop_rounding: integer floor(center - width/2), integer width 4r/8r; reflect101 pad on image boundaries
labels_for_CV: CAL human DIRECT_VISIBLE=1 vs EXTERNAL_OCCLUDED=0 only
folds: LeaveOneGroupOut, five whole sessions, exact feature eligibility shared across families
frozen_feature_preprocessing: within each training fold only: StandardScaler on F4 or F4+F8, PCA32 svd_solver full whitenFalse; RGB26 concatenated afterward; final StandardScaler fit trainfold only
hyperparameter_selection: maximum pooled out-of-fold AUC, tie smaller C, selected on CAL only
threshold_selection: maximum pooled OOF balanced accuracy, tie closest .5 then smaller value
required_metrics: each session AUC and DIRECT/external recall
declared_limitations: CAL hyperparameter/threshold selection is exploratory, not unbiased validation
same-frame overlapping KP patches are correlated; whole-session fold grouping prevents cross-session train/test overlap
pretrained classification representation may lack corner ownership specificity
PCA/scalers must never see heldout fold features during fitting
missing legacy soft-color fields remain imputed as in frozen RGB26 baseline
